sentences.cn_text: 新西兰《2000年雇佣关系法》（ERA）中的个人申诉条款禁止雇主在没有正当理由的情况下解雇员工。
sentences.en_text: The personal grievance provisions of New Zealand’s Employment Relations Act 2000 (ERA) prevent an employer from firing an employee without good cause.

sentences.cn_text: 相反，解雇必须是有正当理由的。
sentences.en_text: Instead, dismissals must be justified.

sentences.cn_text: 雇主既必须说明解雇理由，又必须以程序上公平的方式行事。
sentences.en_text: Employers must both show cause and act in a procedurally fair way.

sentences.cn_text: 个人申诉程序旨在保护普通工人的工作免遭「无理解雇」。
sentences.en_text: Personal grievance procedures were designed to guard the jobs of ordinary workers from “unjustified dismissals”.

sentences.cn_text: 其前提是，合同普通法缺乏足够的保障措施来保护工人免受管理层的专断行为。
sentences.en_text: The premise was that the common law of contract lacked sufficient safeguards for workers against arbitrary conduct by management.

sentences.cn_text: 老板可以简单地向员工发出合同解除通知的日子早已一去不复返。
sentences.en_text: Long gone are the days when a boss could simply give an employee contractual notice.

sentences.cn_text: 但这些条款在应用于高薪经理和高管时给企业造成了困难。
sentences.en_text: But these provisions create difficulties for businesses when applied to highly paid managers and executives.

sentences.cn_text: 正如无数董事会和企业主所证实的那样，限制企业解雇表现不佳的高收入经理的能力，对提高生产力和整体绩效构成了阻碍。
sentences.en_text: As countless boards and business owners will attest, constraining firms from firing poorly performing, high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity and overall performance.

sentences.cn_text: C级经理和A级经理之间的差异很可能就是企业成败之间的差异。
sentences.en_text: The difference between C-grade and A-grade managers may very well be the difference between business success or failure.

sentences.cn_text: 关乎能否保住普通工人的工作。
sentences.en_text: Between preserving the jobs of ordinary workers or losing them.

sentences.cn_text: 然而，平庸已不再足以成为解雇的正当理由。
sentences.en_text: Yet mediocrity is no longer enough to justify a dismissal.

sentences.cn_text: 因此——并且颇为矛盾的是——旨在保护普通工人工作的法律可能正在使这些工作面临风险。
sentences.en_text: Consequently — and paradoxically — laws introduced to protect the jobs of ordinary workers may be placing those jobs at risk.

sentences.cn_text: 即使不是使工作面临风险，就业保护法在限制企业主解雇表现不佳的经理这一层面上，也会对企业生产力乃至工人工资构成制约。
sentences.en_text: If not placing jobs at risk, to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers, those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and therefore on workers’ wages.

sentences.cn_text: 确实，在《新西兰生产力悖论的国际视角》（2014年）中，生产力委员会将管理能力低下列为该国生产力增长记录不佳的一个原因。
sentences.en_text: Indeed, in “An International Perspective on New Zealand’s Productivity Paradox” (2014), the Productivity Commission singled out the low quality of managerial capabilities as a cause of the country’s poor productivity growth record.

sentences.cn_text: 高薪经理人本身也无法免受ERA不合理解雇程序所造成的伤害。
sentences.en_text: Nor are highly paid managers themselves immune from the harm caused by the ERA’s unjustified dismissal procedures.

sentences.cn_text: 由于就业保护法使解雇员工的成本更高，雇主在雇用新员工时更加谨慎。
sentences.en_text: Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff.

sentences.cn_text: 这使得处于边缘地位的经理更难获得工作。
sentences.en_text: This makes it harder for the marginal manager to gain employment.

sentences.cn_text: 而且企业支付给员工的薪资更少，因为企业承担了雇佣关系失败的负担。
sentences.en_text: And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong.

sentences.cn_text: 社会也因过度的就业保护而遭受损害。
sentences.en_text: Society also suffers from excessive employment protections.

sentences.cn_text: 严格的解雇规定对生产力增长产生不利影响，并妨碍繁荣和整体福祉。
sentences.en_text: Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being.

sentences.cn_text: 在塔斯曼海对岸，澳大利亚通过将收入超过指定「高收入门槛」的员工排除在其不公平解雇法的保护范围之外，来应对不合理解雇悖论。
sentences.en_text: Across the Tasman, Australia deals with the unjustified dismissal paradox by excluding employees earning above a specified “high-income threshold” from the protection of its unfair dismissal laws.

sentences.cn_text: 在新西兰，2016年的一项议员个人法案试图允许企业和高收入员工退出不合理解雇制度。
sentences.en_text: In New Zealand, a 2016 private members’ Bill tried to permit firms and high-income employees to contract out of the unjustified dismissal regime.

sentences.cn_text: 然而，所提议的机制过于繁琐，该法案在当年晚些时候政府更迭后被否决。
sentences.en_text: However, the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy and the Bill was voted down following the change in government later that year.

sentences.cn_text: ERA的个人申诉条款旨在____。
sentences.en_text: The personal grievance provisions of the ERA are intended to ____

sentences.cn_text: 惩罚可疑的公司行为
sentences.en_text: punish dubious corporate practices.

sentences.cn_text: 改善传统的招聘程序
sentences.en_text: improve traditional hiring procedures.

sentences.cn_text: 免除雇主的某些职责
sentences.en_text: exempt employers from certain duties.

sentences.cn_text: 保护普通工人的权利
sentences.en_text: protect the rights of ordinary workers.

sentences.cn_text: 从第3段可以得知，这些条款可能____。
sentences.en_text: It can be learned from Paragraph 3 that the provisions may ____

sentences.cn_text: 阻碍企业发展
sentences.en_text: hinder business development.

sentences.cn_text: 削弱经理的权威
sentences.en_text: undermine managers’ authority.

sentences.cn_text: 影响企业的公众形象
sentences.en_text: affect the public image of the firms.

sentences.cn_text: 恶化劳资关系
sentences.en_text: worsen labor-management relations.

sentences.cn_text: 生产力委员会可能会支持以下哪项措施？
sentences.en_text: Which of the following measures would be the Productivity Commission support?

sentences.cn_text: 施加合理的工资限制
sentences.en_text: Imposing reasonable wage restraints.

sentences.cn_text: 执行就业保护法
sentences.en_text: Enforcing employment protection laws.

sentences.cn_text: 限制企业主的权力
sentences.en_text: Limiting the powers of business owners.

sentences.cn_text: 解雇表现不佳的经理
sentences.en_text: Dismissing poorly performing managers.

sentences.cn_text: ERA的不合理解雇程序可能会产生什么影响？
sentences.en_text: What might be an effect of ERA’s unjustified dismissal procedures?

sentences.cn_text: 高薪经理失去工作
sentences.en_text: Highly paid managers lose their jobs.

sentences.cn_text: 员工遭受工资削减
sentences.en_text: Employees suffer from salary cuts.

sentences.cn_text: 社会整体福祉提升
sentences.en_text: Society sees a rise in overall well-being.

sentences.cn_text: 雇主需要雇用新员工
sentences.en_text: Employers need to hire new staff.

sentences.cn_text: 可以推断出，澳大利亚的「高收入门槛」____。
sentences.en_text: It can be inferred that the “high-income threshold” in Australia ____

sentences.cn_text: 保障了经理的收入
sentences.en_text: has secured managers’ earnings.

sentences.cn_text: 产生了不良结果
sentences.en_text: has produced undesired results.

sentences.cn_text: 对企业主有利
sentences.en_text: is beneficial to business owners.

sentences.cn_text: 难以付诸实践
sentences.en_text: is difficult to put into practice.
